table.selectPage: Select all rows on this page

validation.atLeastOneLine: Add at least one line item.
validation.duplicate: This value is already in use.
validation.unknown: Not found — pick from the list.
validation.insufficient: Exceeds available stock — produce or receive more before approving, or save as draft.
validation.mobile: Enter a Bangladeshi mobile number, e.g. 01711-000000.
validation.username: 3–30 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore; start with a letter.
validation.pwMix: Include at least one letter and one digit.
validation.pwSame: Choose a password different from the current one.
validation.pwUsername: The password must not contain your username.
validation.nidOrPassport: Enter a 10, 13 or 17-digit NID, or a passport number (e.g. A1234567).
validation.unknownBranch: Pick a branch that can hold stock (not the head office).
validation.sameBranch: Choose a different branch — goods can't move to where they already are.
validation.lostNote: Explain the loss in at least 10 characters (GD / insurance reference).
validation.unitCode: 1–12 letters, digits or dots, starting with a letter (e.g. Kg, Pcs, Sq.m).
validation.unitInUse: This unit is used by items — its code can't change.
validation.unknownUnit: Pick an active unit from the Units master.
validation.branchInUse: This branch has documents and stock history — it can't become an office.
validation.exceedsRemaining: More than the quantity left to return
validation.notApproved: Only approved purchases can be returned
validation.lcAfterBoe: LC date must be on or before the Bill of Entry date
validation.overrideReason: Give a reason for rates that differ from the tariff
validation.notInTariff: HS code not found in the NBR tariff
validation.foreignService: Foreign vendors cannot supply a local service purchase
validation.inputsOnly: Choose a raw-material or input item
validation.toBeforeFrom: End date is before the start date
validation.beforePurchase: Date is before the purchase date

form.discardBody: You have entered data that hasn't been saved. It will be lost.

dashboard.subtitle: {company} · VAT period {period} · Mushak 9.1 due {date} ({days} days left)
dashboard.stockOk: All items are above re-order level.

sales.title: Sales invoices
sales.subtitle: Mushak 6.3 tax invoices
sales.approvedN: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to approve} one {# document approved} other {# documents approved}}
sales.skippedN: {count, plural, one {# skipped (not a draft)} other {# skipped (not drafts)}}
sales.cancelBody: The invoice will be marked Cancelled and stock returned. A credit note is required if goods were delivered. This cannot be undone.
sales.pdfLater: Server-side PDF (Gotenberg) is wired in R3 — use Print → Save as PDF for now.
sales.newSub: Local or export supply of goods — issues a Mushak 6.3 tax invoice.
sales.customerMasterLater: Customer master (create / edit) ships in R1. Use the existing list for now.
sales.exportNote: Export customer — VAT is zero-rated (0%). Attach the export LC / bill of export in the export module.
sales.sectionItemsHint: SD is charged on value; VAT on value + SD. Figures are rounded to 2 decimals.
sales.searchProduct: Search name, SKU or HS code…
sales.vdsHint: Buyer is a VAT deduction-at-source entity.
sales.approveHint: Approving posts stock movement and includes the invoice in this period's Mushak 6.2 and 9.1. Shortcut: Ctrl+Enter.
sales.editSub: Changes are recorded in the document history.
sales.draftOnlyHint: Your role can save drafts; an approver will review and approve them.
sales.branchHint: Stock leaves this branch when the invoice is approved.

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.subtitle: Local, import and non-registered purchases
purchases.rebateHint: Rebateable VAT is claimed as input tax credit in Mushak 9.1 (note 12–14) within the permitted tax periods.
purchases.newSub: Goods bought from a local registered or non-registered supplier.
purchases.sectionVendorHint: Enter the supplier's Mushak 6.3 challan details.
purchases.nonRegNote: Non-registered supplier — no input VAT credit is available on this purchase.
purchases.importNote: Buying from abroad? Record it from the Bill of Entry.
purchases.challanHint: As printed on the supplier's Mushak 6.3.
purchases.sectionItemsHint: Toggle Rebate off for items not eligible for input credit.
purchases.branchHint: Goods are added to this branch's stock on approval.
purchases.servicesSummary: {count} service purchases · ৳ {total} · input VAT credit ৳ {rebate} · payable ৳ {due}
purchases.newServiceSub: Services received from a local supplier (transport, security, C&F, repairs …). No stock movement.
purchases.serviceNote: Lines use NBR service codes. VDS is pre-ticked for services where VAT must be deducted at source.

items.title: Items
items.subtitle: Raw materials, consumables, packing and finished goods
items.summary: {count} items · stock value ৳ {value} at cost · {low} need re-order
items.newSub: Add a product or material to the item master.

hs.unknown: {hs} isn't in the NBR tariff. Check the code — returns with unknown HS codes are rejected.
hs.error: Couldn't check the tariff right now.

items.masterHint: Optional. Picking one copies its HS code, group, unit and VAT/SD.

placeholder.subtitle: {group} module
placeholder.title: Planned for release {release}
placeholder.body: This page is part of the phased (strangler) migration. Until it ships in the new interface, keep using the existing RBS VAT screen — data stays in the same database, so nothing needs to be re-entered.

auth.noAccessTitle: You don't have access to this page
auth.noAccessHint: Your role doesn't include this action. Ask an administrator if you need it.
auth.hero: Mushak-ready sales, purchases and stock — in one place.

feature.f1: Mushak 6.3 invoices with VAT, SD and VDS computed for you
feature.f2: Input-tax rebate tracked per purchase line for the 9.1 return
feature.f3: Every approval and cancellation recorded with who, when and why

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Use your {company} account.
auth.remember: Keep me signed in for 7 days
auth.invalidLeft: Incorrect username or password. {count, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}} left before a 1-minute lock.
auth.locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {s} s.
auth.expired: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue where you left off.
auth.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.footer: Prototype build · mock data · no real records are changed
auth.disabled: This account has been deactivated. Contact your administrator.
auth.staticDemoBody: There is no server behind this copy: everything you create or change is saved in this browser only, and nobody else sees it.
auth.resetDemoConfirm: Delete every change made in this browser and restore the original demo data?

cancel.title: Cancel {no}?
cancel.bodyApproved: The document is approved: its stock movement will be reversed and it will drop out of the VAT return. This cannot be undone.
cancel.bodyDraft: The draft will be marked cancelled and kept for the audit trail.
cancel.hint: Shown on the document and in its history.

preset.wrongParty: Issued to the wrong party — to be re-issued to the correct one.
preset.wrongQty: Wrong quantity or price entered — to be re-issued.
preset.returned: Goods returned by the buyer before delivery was completed.
preset.duplicate: Duplicate entry of an existing document.

docs.deleteBody: The draft is removed from lists. You can undo right after.
docs.draftNote: Draft — not yet in stock or the VAT return. Approve it to post.
docs.notEditableHint: Only drafts can be edited. Cancel an approved document and issue a new one instead.

ledger.title: Stock ledger — {name}
ledger.summaryNote: Production rows — and damage recorded before damage entries existed — are monthly totals until the Production module ships (R3).
ledger.branchNote: Transfers in and out are shown for a single branch.

parties.inUse: {name} is used on {count, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}} and can't be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
parties.deleteBody: It has no documents. You can undo right after.

hint.name: As printed on the trade licence; stored in capitals.

parties.modeLocked: Type can't change once documents exist — it decides their VAT treatment.

modeHint.Foreign: Outside Bangladesh — exports are zero-rated; imports carry TTI.
modeHint.NonRegistered: Not VAT-registered — no input-tax rebate on purchases.

error.customerMode: Customers must be Local or Foreign.
error.modeLocked: Type can't change once documents exist.

parties.nonRegNote: Purchases from non-registered vendors carry no rebateable VAT (Mushak 6.2 still records them).

customer.title: Customers
customer.subtitle: Buyers on your Mushak 6.3 invoices
customer.newSub: Appears in the customer picker on sales invoices.
customer.foreignNote: Invoices to foreign customers are zero-rated exports (0% VAT, no VDS).
customer.activeHint: Inactive customers can't be picked on new invoices; history is kept.

vendor.title: Vendors
vendor.subtitle: Suppliers on your purchases and imports
vendor.newSub: Appears in the vendor picker on purchases.
vendor.foreignNote: Foreign vendors are for imports (bill of entry); local purchases need a Local or Non-registered vendor.
vendor.activeHint: Inactive vendors can't be picked on new purchases; history is kept.

users.title: Users & roles
users.subtitle: Who can sign in and what each role may do.
users.deactivated: {name} has been deactivated and signed out.
users.deactivateBody: They are signed out immediately and cannot sign in. Their documents and audit history stay unchanged. You can reactivate them at any time.
users.resetBody: A one-time password is generated and their current sessions end. They must choose a new password at the next sign-in.

error.self: You can't change your own role or deactivate yourself — ask another administrator.
error.lastAdmin: At least one active administrator is required.
error.duplicate: This value is already in use.

users.newSub: Creates the account with a one-time password.

hint.username: Used to sign in; cannot be changed later.
hint.usernameFixed: Usernames can't be changed (the audit trail refers to them).
hint.active: Turn off to block sign-in without deleting the account.

roleHint.admin: Everything, including users, company settings and the audit trail.
roleHint.approver: Create, approve and cancel documents; edit master data; view the audit trail.
roleHint.operator: Create and edit draft documents; cannot approve.
roleHint.viewer: Read-only access plus exports and the audit trail (e.g. VAT consultant).

users.selfNote: This is your account: your role and status can only be changed by another administrator.
users.inviteNote: After saving you'll see a temporary password once. Pass it to the user; they must change it at first sign-in.
users.tempBody: Give this password to @{username}. It is shown only once.
users.tempHint: They will be asked to choose their own password when they sign in.
users.matrixSub: Roles are fixed in this release; custom roles are planned for R3. The API enforces the same rules.

company.title: Company profile
company.subtitle: Registration details printed on every Mushak form.
company.lastUpdated: Printed on every Mushak form · last updated by {by} on {when}
company.readOnly: Only an administrator can change the company profile. Ask them if something here is out of date.
company.sectionSignatorySub: Signs VAT returns and is shown on printed Mushak documents.
company.sectionBranchesSub: Factories, warehouses and offices. Branches with a separate BIN need their 4-digit code.

hint.address: Printed as the address of issue on Mushak 6.3.

error.branchMin: Keep at least one branch unit.

company.branchInUse: Branches with documents can't be removed.

tariff.title: Tax tariff
tariff.subtitle: NBR customs and VAT rates by HS code.
tariff.note: Sample of the NBR tariff for the chapters the company trades in. The full schedule (7,000+ codes) is loaded from the official feed in R4. TTI is the total tax on import as a % of assessable value.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.subtitle: Who changed what, and when.
audit.summary: {count} events · append-only, times in Bangladesh time
audit.noChanges: No field changes recorded for this event.
audit.historyNoAccess: The full change history is visible to users with audit access (approvers, admins and auditors).
audit.historyEmpty: No changes recorded for this record yet.
audit.moreChanges: +{n} more fields — open the audit trail for all

password.title: Change password
password.body: Other devices signed in to your account will be signed out.
password.forcedBody: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own password to continue.
password.policy: 8–64 characters, with at least one letter and one digit.

notifications.mustChangePassword: Your password was reset — choose a new one now.
notifications.approvalsSales: {count, plural, one {{n} sales invoice is} other {{n} sales invoices are}} waiting for approval
notifications.approvalsPurchases: {count, plural, one {{n} purchase is} other {{n} purchases are}} waiting for approval
notifications.deadline: {title} — due {date} ({n, plural, one {{days} day} other {{days} days}} left)
notifications.lowStock: {count, plural, one {{n} item is} other {{n} items are}} below reorder level, starting with {first}

transfer.title: Stock transfers
transfer.subtitle: Move goods between your branches — NBR Mushak 6.5.
transfer.summary: {count} transfers · {value} moved at cost · {pending} awaiting approval
transfer.newSub: Mushak 6.5 — stock moves from one branch to the other when the transfer is approved.
transfer.searchPlaceholder: Search transfer no., item, branch or vehicle…
transfer.draftNote: Draft — stock has not moved yet. Approve to move it between the branches.
transfer.mushakNote: The printable Mushak 6.5 (transfer challan) arrives with the NBR reports in R4; the data recorded here is what it will print.
transfer.formNote: A transfer never changes company stock — only where it is. Cancelling an approved transfer moves the goods back if they are still at the receiving branch.

damage.title: Damage & wastage
damage.subtitle: Write off damaged, expired, wasted or lost stock.
damage.summary: {count} entries · {value} written off at cost · {pending} awaiting approval
damage.newSub: Stock leaves the branch when the entry is approved. Keep the QA report or GD reference in the note.
damage.searchPlaceholder: Search entry no., item, branch or note…
damage.draftNote: Draft — stock has not been written off yet.

reasonHint.damaged: Physically damaged in store or handling.
reasonHint.expired: Past shelf life or rejected by QA.
reasonHint.wastage: Normal process loss — set-up waste, edge trim.
reasonHint.lost: Missing or stolen — the note must give the GD or insurance reference.

stock.costNote: Valued at each item's cost price when the document was saved.
stock.shortNote: Some quantities exceed the stock at the source branch. You can save a draft, but it can't be approved until the stock is there.
stock.deleteBody: The draft is removed. Its number is not reused and the audit trail keeps the record.

fg.title: Finished goods
fg.subtitle: Finished-goods stock by branch, valued at cost.
fg.summary: {count} products · {value} at cost · {sale} at sale price

units.title: Units of measure
units.subtitle: The units items are counted in and documents print.
units.newSub: Add a unit such as Sq.m or Dozen.

hint.code: Printed on invoices and challans, e.g. Kg.
hint.active: Inactive units stay on existing items but can't be chosen for new ones.

units.dp: {n, plural, =0 {Whole numbers} one {# decimal place} other {# decimal places}}
units.codeLocked: Used by {n, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} — the code can't change.
units.deleteBody: No item uses this unit. It is removed from the list; the audit trail keeps the record.

imports.newSub: Record goods cleared through customs against a Bill of Entry. Duty rates pre-fill from the NBR tariff.
imports.sectionBoeHint: Supplier, BoE and LC details exactly as printed on the customs document.
imports.sectionDutyHint: AV = USD × exchange rate unless customs re-assessed it. CD, RD, SD, VAT, AIT and AT are computed per line.
imports.notInTariff: HS {hs} is not in the tariff — enter the rates from the BoE
imports.rebateable: VAT + AT claimable as input tax credit
imports.rebateHint: Only VAT and AT are creditable in Mushak 9.1; CD, RD, SD and AIT become part of the cost.

hint.lcDate: On or before the BoE date

debit.title: Debit notes
debit.subtitle: Goods returned to vendors (Mushak 6.8) — reverses stock and input tax credit
debit.draftNote: Draft — stock and input tax are adjusted when it is approved.
debit.rebateNote: Input tax credit to reverse in Mushak 9.1 (note 16): ৳
debit.deleteBody: The draft debit note is removed. Stock and VAT were never affected.
debit.newSub: Return goods from an approved purchase to the vendor.
debit.searchPurchase: Search purchase no., challan or vendor…
debit.pickPurchaseFirst: Select a purchase to list its items.
debit.overNote: A return quantity exceeds what is left on the purchase.
debit.formNote: Values are the returned share of the purchase line (incl. import duties). Approving reduces stock and reverses input tax credit.

hint.purchase: Only approved goods purchases with quantity left to return.

opening.title: Opening stock
opening.subtitle: Quantities brought forward with their value and input-tax class
opening.draftNote: Draft — stock and the item opening balance update when it is approved.
opening.deleteBody: The draft entry is removed. Stock was never affected.
opening.newSub: Bring forward stock held before go-live or at the start of the fiscal year.
opening.formNote: Approving adds the quantity to the branch stock and to the opening row of Mushak 6.1 / 6.2.

hint.price: Unit cost (purchase price, or production cost for finished goods).
hint.vatPaid: Input VAT already paid on this stock (not claimed again).

master.title: Master items
master.subtitle: HS-level products with their tax profile; SKUs inherit from them
master.newSub: Start from the HS code — rates are taken from the NBR tariff.
master.skuCount: {n, plural, =0 {no SKUs} one {# SKU} other {# SKUs}}
master.prefillNote: These rates will pre-fill the tax profile. You can override them in step 3 with a reason.
master.taxIntro: Rates default to the tariff. Changed rates are highlighted and need a reason (kept in the audit log).
master.noTariff: This HS code is not in the tariff — enter the rates manually.
master.overrideWarn: Differs from the tariff: {fields}. Returns will use your rates.
master.skuMismatch: Some SKUs use a different VAT rate than this profile.

b61.subtitle: Inputs bought, consumed and in hand, per item (rule 40(1)(ka) & 41(ka))

b61.emptyHint: Choose a raw material, consumable or packing item to generate its purchase book.

b62.title: Sales book — Mushak 6.2
b62.subtitle: Finished goods produced, sold and in hand, per item (rule 40(1)(kha) & 41(kha))
b62.rule: For taxpayers registered or enlisted under rule 40(1)(kha) and 41(kha)
b62.emptyHint: Choose a finished-goods item to generate its sales book.

book.toBeforeFrom: End date is before the start date.
book.govt: Government of the People’s Republic of Bangladesh · National Board of Revenue
